title: Pick the matcha-café world
question: The roll assigned The Brewing Log for your brown-green redesign. Keep it, take an alternate, re-roll, or play it straight. Every direction opens with: welcome in! I'm

options.label: The Brewing Log
options.lineage: specialty-café brew logs and lab notebooks
options.thesis: Your work recorded the way great coffee is: weighed, timed, tasted — a log where every entry proves the discipline.
options.viewport: Cream pressed-paper page, espresso-brown Fraunces name, one running entry titled 'currently brewing: conectado' set as a recipe grid — role, stack, and measured outcomes in tidy columns; matcha green reserved for links and rules.
options.risk: Recipe-column gimmickry can read costume if the grid isn't strict.

raised.raise: Green is architectural, not garnish: links, section rules, and headers carry olive/matcha; cream stays paper.
State changes move like analog meters: one spring, then settle — never bouncy easings.
One hand-textured moment: a warm pressed-paper wash behind the hero instead of any gradient.

options.label: The Menu Board
options.thesis: The page reads like the wall menu of a café whose product is an engineer: categories, items, and a board you scan in one pass.
options.viewport: Sage-green wall: sections as menu categories, roles as items with dotted leaders running to outcomes; 'today's brew: conectado' highlighted as the special.
options.risk: The closest to where most warm café redesigns already land — familiar territory.

options.label: The Ceremony
options.thesis: The page unfolds like the making of a bowl: measure, whisk, serve — the visit ends with the person served.
options.viewport: A centered cream column where sections arrive as numbered ceremony steps and the CTA is the final step: the bowl, served.
options.case: Fuses cleanly: the scroll reads as a progression; holds clarity, gives up a little identification to the log's rigor.
options.risk: Ceremony framing can obscure 'this is an engineer' if steps carry mood over evidence.

options.label: The Matcha Field
options.thesis: Deep sage-green ground, cream type, espresso actions — the green carries the page so the palette's soul leads.
options.viewport: A full sage-green viewport: cream Fraunces name and body type, espresso brown reserved strictly for primary actions.
options.case: Fuses cleanly: the most committed green there is; loses narrowly on clarity — hierarchy leans on cream wells to stay legible.
options.risk: Green-on-green hierarchy goes muddy fast without cream relief.

options.label: The Barista's Journal
options.case: Fuses poorly: date-diary structure hides role hierarchy from recruiters.

options.label: Brew Gauges
options.case: Fuses poorly: gauge furniture implies data-viz the résumé copy doesn't fill.

options.label: Kiln & Smoke
options.case: Fuses poorly: firing-lab framing buries the hospitality warmth.

options.label: Letter Storm
options.case: Fuses poorly: weathered-type theatrics fight a calm read.
options.kept: Nothing — its weather drama stays behind.

canonCard.label: The Straight Résumé
canonCard.thesis: Clean type, one accent, standard sections — exactly what a great plain portfolio looks like, in your palette.
canonCard.viewport: Centered hero, three tidy sections, standard buttons — the category's well-lit default.
canonCard.risk: None — it is the known quantity.
